protocol: Inspected every frame of the selected YOLO runs and newly used SAM-assisted ranges in numbered 220px context-crop contact sheets. This checks apparent identity and gross box errors, not pixel-accurate geometry or detection completeness. Reviewed before forecasting outcomes. User independent review remains necessary.
